highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 with compiler XML documentation and synchronized HarfBuzz bindings.
highlights_body: The release also corrects a HarfBuzz enum name and removes aggregate flag members that do not represent independent options.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: The corrected upstream name is CCC132 and retains numeric value 132. Update source code that references CCC133 to use CCC132.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed
breaking.body: Aggregate Defined enum values do not represent independent options. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with the concrete flags required by the application.

bullets.detail: Brings the 4.154 preview line to the Chrome m154 renderer and its upstream bug and buffer-upload fixes.

bullets.lead: Package XML documentation is now compiler-generated
bullets.detail: NuGet packages now ship compiler XML documentation sourced from the C# API comments, including Markdown-capable view remarks.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the HarfBuzz native build by scoping compiler warning suppressions

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from Skia's DEPS-pinned native source, keeping supported bindings synchronized with HarfBuzz 14.2.1 while retaining a focused managed API.
